title: RIE Knowledge Graph Entity Node Contract
description: Formal contract defining the structure and validation constraints of an Entity Node in the RIE Knowledge Graph.

id.description: Unique identifier of the entity node.

entity_type.description: Classification of the entity node within the RIE domain model.

title.description: Human-readable label or designation of the entity.

confidence_score.description: Deterministic epistemic confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0.

status.description: Operational lifecycle state of the node.

provenance_ref.description: Reference to the governing lineage or source container.
